title: Nutritional powder mix, sugar free (Slim Fast)

content.title: About
content.content: Slim Fast sugar‑free nutritional powder mix is designed for quick preparation of low‑calorie drinks, helps maintain satiety and supports weight management. The powder provides protein, vitamins and minerals without added sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Slim Fast was first launched in the 1970s as part of a weight‑control program.
The powder dissolves easily in water or milk, creating a smooth beverage.
Several flavors are available, including vanilla, chocolate and strawberry.
Athletes and active individuals often use it for rapid nutrient replenishment.
The mix is gluten‑free and suitable for most diets, except those avoiding artificial sweeteners.

items.title: Supports satiety
items.content: High protein and fiber content helps keep you feeling full longer.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6 and B12 aid normal metabolism and energy production.

items.title: Mineral complex
items.content: Includes calcium, magnesium and iron, essential for bones and blood formation.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: No added sugar makes it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Convenient
items.content: Quick to prepare, facilitating adherence to a regular eating schedule.

items.title: Milk‑protein allergy
items.content: Some versions contain whey protein, which may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Contains sucralose or aspartame, which may not be suitable for sensitive individuals.

items.title: Vitamin excess
items.content: Overconsumption could lead to exceeding recommended daily intakes of certain vitamins.

items.title: Not a meal replacement
items.content: Intended as a supplement, not as the sole source of nutrition.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one scoop (about 30 g) of powder with 250 ml of water, milk or a plant‑based beverage, shake well. For extra flavor and texture, add fruit, berries or nuts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed to prevent moisture ingress.
